notes: Reconciles p5-002 discovery and p5-001 manifests into the SQLite library through one WriteAsync transaction under the frozen Steam plugin GUID, matching imported records by plugin id plus canonical app id and using a deterministic version-5 identity for new records. Provider-owned name, install directory, install size and install state only; OverrideInstallState protects both install-directory and install-state fields and every other field, including tracker-owned playtime, is preserved. Records are never deleted: an app absent from an authoritative discovery is marked not installed and counted Removed. Every skipped app is reported by id and stable reason; unavailable or incomplete discovery never marks games uninstalled. Review fix: reconciliation requires positive proof of a complete, non-empty observation, so a rejected or truncated library file, an entry the parser drops, an unavailable library without a declared app set, an emptied library app set and an entirely empty enumeration each withdraw authority, report library-file-rejected/library-entry-dropped/library-apps-unknown/library-apps-emptied and perform zero removals; integration tests cover a dropped entry, a detached library with an emptied app set, an emptied and an undeclared app set on a reachable library, and a clean parse that projects no app and no skip. Repeat sync over unchanged input reports zero changes. UI-free, network-free, no schema or protected-oracle change.
